exposure: Minimally invasive suction of the gestational sac content
Systemic methotrexate injection (25 mg followed by 50 mg)
outcome: Decline in beta human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels to negative
cohort: A 23-year-old female who presented with mild vaginal bleeding and was diagnosed with a viable cesarean scar pregnancy of 7 weeks' gestation.
finding: The described minimally invasive treatment, combining suction of the gestational sac content with local and systemic methotrexate, is an acceptable approach for cesarean scar pregnancy, particularly when embryonic cardiac activity is present.
mod_finding: The study details the management of cesarean scar pregnancy, a life-threatening complication in patients with a prior cesarean delivery.
followup_time: Weekly until negative beta hCG levels were established
